newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM steps up thermoplastic rubber capacity.
newsitem.headline: DSM steps up thermoplastic rubber capacity.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group DSM NV said on Friday its elastomers unit had started up a new European production line for Sarlink thermoplastic rubbers, boosting total capacity to 15,000 tonnes a year.
"This line has an annual capacity of 5,000 tonnes and is located at DSM Specialty Compounds in Genk(Belgium)," DSM said in a statement.
DSM Thermoplastic Elastomers, part of the elastomers division, already operates a 10,000 tonne plant in Massachusetts, USA.

A blend of vulcanised rubber and plastic, Sarlink is used in the automotive, construction and electrical equipment industries for making seals on windows and doors and for so-called 'soft touch' electronic applications.
DSM said the world thermoplastic rubbers market was growing at a rate of some 10 percent annually and sales of Sarlink had almost doubled each year in recent years.
DSM Thermoplastic Elastomers' strategy was aimed at capturing some 20 percent of the world market by the year 2000, it added.
